finding: In a submodule mount the manifest is the upstream's, so every absent path resolves to not-mounted and Missing is unreachable; a deleted hook, rule or the .claude/scripts link passes with exit 0. The -d .loa/.claude probe lets any checkout opt into the lenient mode.
reasoning_trace: Read check_integrity (:56-88) against mount-submodule.sh's symlink/copy set; the branch at :75 fires for every manifest path in a submodule mount; dissent DISS-C-001 adds the probe weakness.
remediation: Record the linked set and treat only unlinked paths as not-mounted; fail on absent hooks/rules/scripts; gate the mode on a real gitlink.

finding: jq reserved word label used as --arg variable and key; syntax error on jq 1.6 (the Dockerfile.ablation toolchain). run_phase aborts before any phase; 39/52 pipeline-run.bats cases fail here.
reasoning_trace: Reproduced: jq-1.6 rejects '{label: $label}' and '{name, label}'; bats run on a scratch copy of head: 13 ok / 39 not ok, all with the keyword error. Also :702, :816-826, :881-882.
remediation: Rename to $lbl and quote the key; add a jq-1.6 self-test or run the suite inside the ablation image in CI.

finding: Shorthand key label is a jq 1.6 syntax error; ROW assignment fails and no row is written, so runs.jsonl is empty and spend.sh under-counts.
reasoning_trace: Same root cause as CQ-001; reproduced with jq -n '{name:"a",label:"b"} | {name, label}'.
remediation: "label": .label

finding: evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/runs/ is not in the change; took-effect.bats and ablation-row.bats fail in setup (0/39) and the new CI step 'bats evals/tests/' is red on checkout.
reasoning_trace: head.diff has no ablation-runs/runs/ entry; MANIFEST.json arm_map names ten absent run dirs; observed setup failure on the scratch copy. Also ablation-row.bats:19, bats-tests.yml:212-223.
remediation: Commit the regenerated runs/ (after the jq fix, on jq 1.6) or regenerate in setup().

finding: integrity_clean reads the mount-time manifest_sha256 pin but only annotates on match; every entry is verified against the sandbox manifest the agent can rewrite, so a tampered .claude/ with a regenerated checksums.json passes.
reasoning_trace: Traced :233-268; pin from meta/pipeline.json (outside the sandbox) is available but a mismatch does not return 1; Bash writes are not seen by ablation-row's dot_claude_writes.
remediation: Return 1 on pin mismatch; add a tamper bats case.

finding: Tracked-only count misses untracked additions to .claude/ and deleted tracked files; both secondary signals lost (dissent DISS-C-002; review DISS-001).
reasoning_trace: git ls-files lists tracked paths regardless of working-tree presence and never lists untracked files; previous find-based count moved on both.
remediation: Filter with [[ -f ]] and keep a find-based comparison for additions.

finding: init_sandbox_beads executes the sandbox's own .claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh on the host, contradicting the header's trust-boundary claim (:75, :97-99) and pipeline-run.sh:125-126.
reasoning_trace: Code read; the trust-boundary bats case greps only 'source' lines.
remediation: Write the opt-out marker from the library or run it inside the container; extend the boundary test.

finding: Comment assumes the opt-out marker is written because br is absent from the image, but init_sandbox_beads runs on the host (pipeline-run.sh:489) and uses the host's br when present.
remediation: Set LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN to a non-existent path in container mode.

finding: Operator codex auth.json copied into <run>/meta/home; removed only by EXIT trap/finish, so a SIGKILLed driver leaves OAuth tokens in the results tree.
reasoning_trace: make_home :563-573; remove_tree only in finish/on_exit; header :104-106 names the SIGKILL case.
remediation: Keep credentials in a private tmp dir or a read-only third mount; sweep meta/home before archiving.

finding: Whole ledgers and envelopes passed as single --argjson argv strings; Linux MAX_ARG_STRLEN 128 KiB → E2BIG on large runs, row lost.
reasoning_trace: jq invocation :224-228; MINV wraps the whole MODELINV ledger.
remediation: --slurpfile / --rawfile.

finding: Exit 137 with timed_out=false is classified interrupted; an OOM-killed phase under --memory 4g vanishes via the suite's exclusion.statuses instead of counting as agent_error.
remediation: Drop --rm, inspect .State.OOMKilled, classify as agent_error.

finding: Container /tmp is noexec by docker default; tasks executing from a hard-coded /tmp fail as agent_error.
reasoning_trace: findmnt /tmp on this host shows rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec for the same option string.
remediation: Add exec to the tmpfs options or validate test_command against /tmp.

finding: Header documents uppercase snapshot keys; :788 lowercases them.
remediation: Fix the comment.

finding: is_error stays true after gate_recovered resets rc=0.
remediation: Derive is_error from the recovered state.

finding: pricing.py under .claude/adapters is executed despite the 'No .claude/ code' claim at :125; it is the harness's trusted copy.
remediation: Say so in the comment or move the CLI under evals/.

finding: Arm-id leak grep scans the whole mounted .claude/ tree; a future framework mention refuses every run of that arm.
remediation: Scope the scan to fixture and grimoire paths.

finding: Per-operator bats fallback path hard-coded; :62 folds stderr into the version line.
remediation: Drop the personal path; capture stdout only.

finding: Placeholder gpt-6.1-sol pricing drives the codex-headless hop; MODELINV rows carry pricing_source: config without a provisional marker (dissent DISS-C-005).
remediation: Add placeholder/price_date marker surfaced in rows.

finding: Symlinked checksums.json target not validated to lie under PROJECT_ROOT before git -C runs there (dissent DISS-C-003).
remediation: Check the resolved path prefix.

finding: Envelopes read from the agent-writable sandbox first, eval/ copy only as fallback (dissent DISS-C-004).
remediation: Prefer eval/.

finding: brbuild stage is unreferenced (dead under BuildKit) and by the file's own note cannot build under the classic builder.
remediation: Remove the stage.

finding: Validator requires review_catch.fixture under evals/fixtures/ while pipeline-run.sh:441 also resolves task-dir/suite-root paths.
remediation: Align the two.
